overview_description.description: KULAR is a clean technology company that develops carbon-negative combustion platforms that are scalable. The goal of the company is to enhance efficient combustion into as many “burner applications” as possible and in doing so, to displace inefficient and polluting burners currently utilizing fossil fuels. The company empowers individuals to change the world by giving them the technology to effect positive change.
